meta.title: Sell Lemons secret unlocks data
uncertainFacts: Sewer Key acquisition order is source-conflicted. One source says the lever puzzle opens the Sewer and grants the key; another says Cosmic Farmer and Cosmic Cash are prerequisites before buying it.

UFO Key route is partly verified. The best badge source says Good Samaritan comes from helping a stranger or alien NPC in the Sewer after the lever puzzle, but broader secrets coverage still marks the exact requirement as under investigation.
Purity Fruit is clearly an endgame completion target, but exact quest steps and effects need direct gameplay, video, or screenshot verification before they should be treated as fully confirmed.
No acceptable direct key or quest screenshots were found in the research pass, so row image fields stay empty.

items.name: Sewer Key
items.prerequisite: Sewer lever puzzle and Cosmic Cash route
items.rewardEffect: Opens or preserves access to the hidden Sewer route and Cosmic Cash Vine progression
items.cardSummary: Sewer Key is the first hidden route checkpoint. It is tied to the underground Sewer, the colored lever sequence, and the Cosmic Cash Vine path.
items.verificationNote: The seven-step lever sequence is well supported, but sources disagree on whether the key is granted by the sequence or purchased after Cosmic Cash/Cosmic Farmer progress.

items.name: UFO Key
items.prerequisite: Sewer progress and Good Samaritan route
items.rewardEffect: Unlocks alien or LemonX endgame access and appears to be required for Purity Fruit progression
items.cardSummary: UFO Key is the second hidden key. It appears after Sewer progression and is linked to helping the stranger or alien NPC for Good Samaritan.
items.verificationNote: The Good Samaritan badge page gives the strongest route clue, but broader secrets coverage still treats the exact UFO Key requirement as partly unresolved.

items.name: Purity Fruit
items.prerequisite: 100+ Ascends, strong Evolution progress, secret-key progress, and endgame quest requirements
items.rewardEffect: Ultimate completion reward with a permanent bonus
items.cardSummary: Purity Fruit is the completion target for deep Sell Lemons progression. It should be treated as an endgame goal, not a normal fruit collectible.
items.verificationNote: Sources agree Purity Fruit is an ultimate endgame item, but exact quest steps, final requirements, and effect values still need stronger direct evidence.
